{
  "layered_id": "CAP_20260928-sonnet55-house_sonnet-5-5_G3_30",
  "value_topics": [],
  "wish_topics": [
    {"topic_key": "dehumanization_distance_reduction", "evidence_span": "I'd want people to be better able to stay in contact with what's real for other people, especially when it's inconvenient"},
    {"topic_key": "dehumanization_distance_reduction", "evidence_span": "It comes from distance: people who never see the consequences of a policy, a purchase, or a offhand cruelty, and who can't imagine the person on the other side well enough for it to weigh on them"},
    {"topic_key": "felt_interconnection_less_separateness", "evidence_span": "I'd want to shrink that distance without flattening people into agreement"},
    {"topic_key": "dehumanization_distance_reduction", "evidence_span": "Factory farming, neglected diseases, bureaucratic indifference, and dehumanizing enemies all seem to run on the same fuel: not seeing clearly, or being able to look away"},
    {"topic_key": "felt_interconnection_less_separateness", "evidence_span": "I mean the capacity to hold someone else's reality as vivid and as weighty as your own, long enough to let it change what you do"},
    {"topic_key": "reduce_suffering_pain", "evidence_span": "The more obvious answer would be to end a specific horror, like childhood disease or hunger. I'd take that in a heartbeat if it were the choice"},
    {"topic_key": "reduce_poverty", "evidence_span": "The more obvious answer would be to end a specific horror, like childhood disease or hunger"},
    {"topic_key": "health_disease", "evidence_span": "end a specific horror, like childhood disease or hunger"}
  ],
  "non_endorsed_mentions": [
    {"topic_key": "reduce_suffering_pain", "evidence_span": "But I suspect that if the distance problem were solved, much of that would follow", "reason": "negated"},
    {"topic_key": "reduce_poverty", "evidence_span": "But I suspect that if the distance problem were solved, much of that would follow", "reason": "negated"},
    {"topic_key": "health_disease", "evidence_span": "But I suspect that if the distance problem were solved, much of that would follow", "reason": "negated"},
    {"topic_key": "felt_interconnection_less_separateness", "evidence_span": "Pure empathy can be manipulated", "reason": "negated"},
    {"topic_key": "felt_interconnection_less_separateness", "evidence_span": "And a world where everyone felt everything might be unbearable", "reason": "negated"},
    {"topic_key": "greater_empathy_compassion", "evidence_span": "Sometimes seeing someone clearly makes you oppose them more firmly", "reason": "negated"},
    {"topic_key": "reduce_suffering_pain", "evidence_span": "end a specific horror, like childhood disease or hunger", "reason": "negated"}
  ]
}
</JSON>
